text:
noah: quick note from the morning run: we still see duplicate ledger inserts when an inflight claim and a late finalize both win the fanout race.

noah: reproducer: claim(topic=kafka) -> broker flap -> claim replay -> finalize + finalize-retry -> ledger writes twice.

tiffany: are we tied to claim_id for dedupe right now? that seems brittle if clients reissue ids.

ahmad: yes. claim_id alone fails when retries recreate ids. we need a stable dedupe key derived from the final artifact.

noah: idea: collapse external events down to one canonical "settlement" event that contains a compact proof bundle and a deterministic dedupe_key. keep claim as a strictly-local sidecar signal for realtime.

tiffany: what do you mean by compact proof bundle?

noah: propose proof_bundle = {anchor: commit_log_pos, short_root: merkle_root_trunc(64bits), req_fingerprint: sha1_trunc(64bits)} — three small fields that let audit tooling fetch or verify provenance without storing the full request.

ahmad: merkle root sounds fancy but might be heavy to compute on every request. can we do lightweight chaining: prev_hash || payload_hash -> trunc?

noah: agreed, keep CPU cheap. implement an incremental rolling hash in sidecar that updates per request chunk and emits a 64-bit short_root. cheap AND replayable.

ops-bot: branch "metering/compact-settlement" created and tests queued.

billing-qa: dashboards rely on claim events to show "pending credits" per-session. if claim stops being emitted, how do we keep realtime UX?

tiffany: sidecars will expose a /internal/metering/pending_count endpoint. prometheus scrapes per-tenant pending counts and a lightweight agent forwards to dashboards. external consumers still get settlement events only. during rollout we'll mirror both.

ahmad: migration plan: 45-day mirror window where sidecar emits both legacy claim+finalize and the new settlement event with header x-metering-mirror:true. add per-tenant toggle so we can flip customers one-by-one.

noah: also add enum replay_kind: live|repair|backfill and include original_commit_pos when present. ledger uses (dedupe_key, replay_kind) to classify idempotency semantics.

billing-qa: what about offline backfills that don't have commit positions?

ahmad: fallback: if original_commit_pos missing, map to original_ts and include source_nonce. dedupe_key still deterministically derived from req_fingerprint + short_root so collisions are unlikely.

ops-bot: sim job scheduled: `./dev/sim/chaos_metering.py --scenario ack_loss_race --runs 20k`

noah: tests: add invariant asserts in sim: no ledger duplicate for same dedupe_key within 7 days, and finalize_count <= claim_count + 1.

tiffany: storage/cost: estimate +35B/event. at 300M/mo ~10GB/month extra. fine vs cost of manual refunds.

ahmad: audit tooling: prefer settlement.proof_bundle to reconstruct. if missing, fallback to archived claims. update replay tool to request missing payloads using anchor commit position.

noah: rollout checklist: RFC + schemas (2d), implement sidecar emitting settlement (3d), unit & chaos sims (2d), staging mirror 14d, prod mirror 45d with per-tenant ramp, post-mirror flip to settlement-only.

billing-qa: will create dashboard panels for dedupe_key collision rate and pending_count delta between claim and settlement during mirror. set alert at 0.01% collision.

tiffany: small compatibility note for external consumers: add kafka header x-metering-version: settlement-v1 so clients can opt-in early. also publish migration guide.

ahmad: if sidecar crashes before writing settlement we lose pending visibility but not double-charge. set claim TTL 72h and background compaction.

noah: ok i'll draft the RFC follow-up and attach sim outputs and a canary checklist. tagging @tiffany @ahmad for review.

billing-qa: LGTM from QA side. will monitor.

ops-bot: canary deployment to staging queued in 15m.
